title: Mixed Event — Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas — Episode8 Smiles Connected By Art

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas
meta.Event Outline: Ena decides to go back to her former art class, but her teacher, Mr. Yukihira, tells her that her drawing lacks appeal. Meanwhile, Honami feels anxious about job shadowing, tasked with teaching a subject she struggles with...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Ms. Honami!
What do you think of my drawing?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You've painted a wonderful crocodile...!
And the meat it's having looks very yummy.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
It does?
Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Honami!
Did you see a cute crocodile like the one you drew?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I'm wondering because it looks so different from the one I saw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I... I just drew my crocodile in a way that would be easily recognizable to others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, mind drawing a crocodile for us? You know, how you normally would...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Yes, some people might laugh at it because it doesn't look real...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm sure someone will understand as long as you try your best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And...
I'm sorry for not realizing that sooner. That should've been the first thing I taught you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's completely fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'll try drawing one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
You can do it, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I remember seeing one when we went to a zoo for a field trip during elementary school. It was so scary...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was scary, but I couldn't stop looking at it...)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Whoa! What is this?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Haha!
It looks all funny.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Honami, you were so good until just a second ago! What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Oh no... I knew this would...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It's scary and really cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It doesn't look like a crocodile, but it also kinda does!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It looks like it's ready to attack at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, this seems like a good time for me to exit since we're all happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Aren't you gonna paint something, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me? But I'm not actually a part of this shadowing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Let's paint something together!
I wanna see what your crocodile looks like!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
No, we don't need more crocodiles!
Paint a different animal!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, draw lots of animals for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...? U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for some painting?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to you, the children seem to be really enjoying themselves and painting some wonderful animals. Plus, you're a friend of Ms. Mochizuki and Ms. Otori, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ena...
Please, join us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The children and I would really love to keep painting with you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I guess, what choice do I have...?
Especially if you're all willing to say that much...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, done!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are these a pair of wolves...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I remember seeing them at a zoo a really long time ago. I also remember how scared my little brother was of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But they looked adorable to me, so I decided to draw a scary-looking one and a cute one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
That's why they seem so different from each other!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wow!
They look really funny together, but I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Funny...?
You could've chosen a slightly nicer word...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, I really do like it!
Paint some more for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, let's keep painting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Last but not least, let's paint in a sun and... All done!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yay! It's like an amusement park for our animals!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow...
They look like they're having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So many animals painted in so many different styles...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a masterpiece!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Honami, Ms. Emu... And Ms. Ena.
Thank you all for joining us today!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: The children had a wonderful time painting thanks to you. We really appreciate what you did for us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, no...!
I'm just glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: You'll always be welcome here, so don't be strangers!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we have to say goodbye to our visitors now. Let's give them a nice send-off!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Come back soon!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bye bye!
Let's draw together again!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See you!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for what you did today, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all had a wonderful time painting today thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you were totally the reason why everybody was all smiles in the end! Thank you so very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was nothing, really.
I'm just happy that I could help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you did more than that...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mind was so preoccupied with my inability to draw that I couldn't learn to enjoy what I create...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I finally was able to do a little bit today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? That's great...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, you helped me realize what makes a piece of art appealing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I did...?
It doesn't feel like I've done anything, but I'm glad to hear that I was able to help you somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, Ena... There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If possible, when you have some free time, would you mind teaching me how to draw again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Today, when I was painting...
I actually had fun while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not very good and don't feel entirely comfortable drawing in front of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I feel like I can really enjoy it if I learn to draw like you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like that too!
I wanna draw with you two again☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll let you know when I have some free time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. If I'm gonna teach you to draw, why don't we do sketches like a real class?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sketches...?!
That sounds kind of difficult... But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want us to draw something on a big canvas, so I can hang it up in my living room!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is turning into a big project all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it sounds like fun, so let's meet up again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, I'm exhausted...
But I had a lot of fun today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And everybody was having a ton of fun painting towards the end...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Today, when I was painting...
I actually had fun while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not very good and don't feel entirely comfortable drawing in front of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I feel like I can really enjoy it if I learn to draw like you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm glad I could help Honami learn the joy of drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I haven't touched that assignment that's due next week yet!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I've gotta get going on it...!
I have to fix everything that I was told last time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, I really do like it!
Paint some more for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I should try drawing the wolves that I drew today. A little more seriously this time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Huh...? My hand is moving without hesitation for some reason...
I've had so much on my mind lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep going for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My perspective's all messed up, and so are the details... I bet Mr. Yukihira's gonna have a field day with this one... But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I like what I've made.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My skills still need improving and I'm not able to express things exactly the way I want, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna keep trying!
I'm gonna keep drawing until I feel satisfied!)
